caseNameFull: Brown v. Pro Football, Inc., dba Washington Redskins

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1021.] Motions of Screen Actors Guild, Inc., et al. and National Hockey League Players Association et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
